name: Package pony
tips: `apt search word` (or `dnf search word`) looks for packages whose name or description contains that word.
`apt show bashou` prints everything about one package: its version, size, dependencies and description.
A package is a program wrapped with what the system needs to install, update and remove it cleanly.
personal: I brought you something! It's a package.
Sharing is the best part of free software.
Read the description: there's always a surprise inside.
